title: Binding of the Nimbus (Thrive clone) design-repo to the N0 common SaaS design-constraint policy

classification.marketModel: B2B subscription software sold sales-led to organisations: annual plans, per-learner pricing brackets, demo booking, segment pages by company size, integrations and admin/reporting features
classification.decision: B2B SaaS. The clone sells a learning platform to organisations: per-learner pricing brackets and annual plans, a demo-booking flow instead of self-serve sign-up, landing pages per company size (small business, corporate, enterprise), an integrations directory and admin/analytics/dashboard features. Testimonials come from job titles such as 'Global Head of Learning'. These are exactly the constructs the common SaaS policy assumes.

evidence.fact: routes /lms/small-business, /lms/corporate-lms, /lms/enterprise, /lms/integrations, /lms/demo-platform and /pricing: segment pages by company size, integrations directory, demo booking, pricing
pricing calculator: 'Number of learners' bracket select (per-learner B2B pricing)
global nav CTA 'Book a demo' linking to /lms/demo-platform (sales-led acquisition, no self-serve sign-up)
admin panel (users, permissions, enrolments at any scale) and dashboards/reporting features
testimonial from a 'Global Head of Learning' (organisational buyer)

classification.originalSiteNote: The original (thrivelearning.com, a real company; the saved page's title reads 'Learning and Development Platform | L&D Software | Thrive') is an L&D SaaS vendor; the clone replaces its brand with the placeholder Nimbus.
classification.consideredAlternative: consumer-app / marketplace: rejected. Nothing in the clone sells to individual consumers or matches two sides of a marketplace; every surface addresses organisations buying software seats.

generationRules: Pages are drawn only from the 33 templates (7 families) and 96 section contracts of this design-repo; nothing the source lacks (self-serve checkout, app-store download, consumer sign-up, changelog) may be invented.
Pricing pages keep the real structure (learner-bracket calculator, plan cards, one primary demo CTA); in mode=generation every price, bracket and figure is original (GENERATION_MODE_CLAIM).
Demo and contact forms stay static placeholders with no endpoint (DEMO_FORM_STAYS_STATIC).

mode=generation pages carry no source brand (Nimbus, Nova, Thrive, Kiki), domain, CTA, copy, people, customers, screenshots, embeds or proprietary assets (GENERATION_MODE_* rules; assets/asset-roles.json availability, pinned in code).
PageSpecs use approved token paths only (tokens/llm/token-policy.json, TOKEN_* rules).
contentHashRule: registry.manifest.json designPolicy.contentHash = 'sha256:' + sha256 over, for each enforcedBy path in this order, the UTF-8 path, a newline, the file bytes and a newline -- with policy/design-policy.json itself hashed as written (it contains no hash). extraction/verify_all.py (design-policy) recomputes it.

approval.note: The SaaS classification was made by an agent from the evidence above (agent attestation, not a human sign-off). A human architecture owner must ratify the binding.
